page.overview:
Who is 399 (LMD)?

399 observed the individual responsible for the destruction but did not initially identify him as a threat. MODOK Superior noted that this was unusual, as the individual was normally one of New York's protectors. The figure was Benjamin Grimm, the Thing, who had been transformed into a powerful, magically enhanced creature after coming into contact with the Hammer of Angrir.
